source_info.inventory_note: Inventory is point-in-time. Stock counts are included only when visibly shown by Walgreens. Unknown means no store-specific result was observed; it is not an out-of-stock result. Existing source records are preserved with their original checked_on dates.
source_info.price_note: Walgreens prices are online listing prices checked on the date shown. Sale prices and in-store prices may vary.
source_info.location_note: Hudson County Walgreens and Duane Reade locations were gathered from the public Walgreens locator. New coordinates come from the store page Get directions destination and may identify the store pin rather than the pharmacy entrance. Existing coordinates and route estimates are preserved.
source_info.dataset_scope: Original dataset plus deduplicated Hudson County store additions.

source_info.dataset: Additive Walgreens OTC product and inventory research
source_info.source_method: Products, online prices, and inventory counts were read manually from visible Walgreens product pages and the Check other stores inventory drawer. No automated scraping was used.
source_info.inventory_note: Counts are point-in-time quantities shown by Walgreens in the visible store inventory drawer. The seven requested NJ stores are represented for every product. fexofenadine at Willow Ave was explicitly shown Out of stock with the in-stock filter disabled. Other entries were shown with positive counts.
source_info.price_note: Prices are Walgreens online product-page prices at check time. They may vary in store and may change; displayed promotional offers are not included in the base price.
